Hit a little snag?
Kikoo is here to help.

From photos and saving to coins, accounts, and privacy, send a DM to @kikioo_selfie_club on Instagram.

A few details can help

Tell us your device model, iOS version, Kikoo version, and when and how the issue happened. Please do not send personal photos or videos, passwords, or card numbers.

Paid, but your coins aren't showing?

  1. Check that you are signed in to the Kikoo account linked to the purchase.
  2. On the app's purchase screen, use ‘Check Purchases’ to verify the existing transaction and sync your balance again. This does not start a new purchase.
  3. If the issue continues, contact us with the product name, purchase date, and Apple order number. You do not need to attach a full receipt containing personal information.

Spent coins are not granted again, and restoring a consumable coin purchase through the store does not reissue its balance. Contact us before paying for the same item again.

Need a refund?

You can request a refund for an Apple in-app purchase through Apple's official process. Kikoo can help with delivery errors and transaction checks. Your consumer rights under applicable law remain in effect.

Frequently asked questions

Where are my photos saved?+

Captured and edited media is processed on your device. Kikoo does not send photos to the Company's cloud, so export anything you want to keep to your photo library.

Will my photos move if I change accounts?+

Photos are not synced with your account. Keep copies on your device. Check supported service information, such as coins and content entitlements, with the same linked account.

How can I delete my account or personal information?+

Send a request using the privacy contact link below. After verifying your account, we will explain what can be deleted and which transaction records must be retained by law. Do not send a password or ID photo.
